notes: COMPLETE GAME EXPERIENCE - TITLE + HOME PASS. KWARS1 now opens on a real KINGDOM WARS title screen (ENTER, optional CONTINUE shortcut, compact settings/audio/version) and enters a command-centre home with live player state: era, kingdoms conquered, best Endless wave, gems and legacy rank. Navigation is hierarchical - PLAY and CONTINUE WAR first, then World Crusade / Endless War / Army / Armory / Shop, then Daily Orders, Achievements, Records and Settings. PLAY opens a real mode select built on the existing Campaign and Endless systems, and both routes run through the existing pre-battle loadout screen. The post-battle overlay is now a full results screen reporting only tracked values (wave or kingdom, kills, gold, legacy XP, gems earned, crowns, milestones) with Next Battle / Retry / Campaign / Army / Home. SAVE-INTEGRITY FIX: the results-screen replay used to start a battle directly, skipping active-run clearing, persistence, loadout and civ setup; every battle start and retry now goes through one canonical KWExperience.startBattle() and the second path is removed. HONESTY: the false LEADERBOARDS destination is renamed RECORDS and states that global rankings need accounts that do not exist yet; achievements are derived milestones with nothing to claim, so no save field is added; the gem top-up is withheld while the payment path cannot complete. No gameplay, combat, cohort, formation or renderer change. Save schema remains 3. Build 53: clamp the fort percentage on the home/continue readout (a save with an inflated gateHP rendered 100000000000%). Build 54: service-worker install and revalidation now bypass the browser HTTP cache. A cache-name bump alone was not enough - when a deploy landed inside the CDN max-age window the new cache installed the PREVIOUS build and kept re-seeding itself, pinning clients to a stale build.
